problems.what: The lane relaxed its own new impact gate: RMS_RISE_MAX_MS 3.0 -> 4.0 (decoded), and IMPK/ULTK max_gr_db 6 -> 9, in the same commit that made the impacts pass
problems.evidence: git show 1ecd4c6ae -- audio/build.py audio/cues/impacts.py. My decode: impact RMS rise max 3.5 (ults) / 3.73 ms (heavies), median 2.8 / 2.7. The brief's 3 ms onset bar holds on the sample peak (max 2.85 ms). The engineer reported both changes. Crest factor rose 9.6 -> 10.5 dB, so the extra gain reduction did not flatten the hits.
problems.fix: Get the decoded RMS rise back to 3 ms or less, for example a slightly earlier strike to make up for the Opus pre-echo, or a 1 ms pre-emphasis at -40 dB, and return the gate to 3.0. Otherwise record the 4 ms ruling in owner_rulings.md.

problems.what: Within each fighter, the impacts are now much closer to the shared hit they replace. They are no longer cross-fighter templates, but they also stand out less as an ult
problems.evidence: Third-octave distance from each ult to the same fighter's f_<id>_hit: median 15.6 -> 8.4 dB, min 7.4 -> 6.85 (burdam, sukri 7.1, marund 7.3, lisvel 7.4). Heavy to shared: median 11.7 -> 9.0, min 5.9 -> 5.2 (ulkro). Ult to the same fighter's heavy: median 6.2, min 4.05 (lisvel). The level lead over the shared hit (+1.6 to +2.6 dB) carries most of the 'this was the ult' read.
problems.fix: Add an ult-only layer per fighter (the ring/boom tail or a pitched signature above 2 kHz) and gate ult vs own shared hit at >= 8 dB.

problems.evidence: Seed 3 Lisvel master -16.78 LUFS (verify1_r -16.97), with the bound at -16.5. The sfx bus is -18.65 and f_lisvel_a1_hit is the top cue at 10.95 % of heard sfx. The brighter impacts add K-weighted energy.
problems.fix: Trim the heavy impacts' catalog gain by about 0.5 dB, or trim f_lisvel_a1_hit, and re-check seeds 3 and 21.

problems.what: Take-variation figures depend on the metric
problems.evidence: The engineer's tf_sim gives a take median of 0.907 / 0.916. My log-STFT correlation gives 0.966 (ults) / 0.955 (heavies), max 0.978. Round 1 on my metric was 0.981 / 0.973. It is better on both metrics, but the takes still differ mostly in level and noise on mine.
problems.fix: Add per-take pitch and contact-time jitter on the voiced blow layer.
